applies_why: The judge text decides whether verses on a cited-in line count as unanswered witnesses toward a broken link.
quote: the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted: reading one excludes answered verses from counting regardless of a pressing quote; reading two still requires a pressing quote for a retraction. The plain text favors reading one.
why: The judge says the witnesses were answered and no link is BROKEN, so no verse is counted as an unanswered witness under K-G4.
